haiku.problem: The question uses "His" for Jesus before Jesus is named, which breaks the rule against pronouns before the person is identified. It should read "when the Pharisees objected to Jesus' disciples picking grain..." or similar.

The main point of the passage is that the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath, which is the title's point. The card about that (1-9) was left out, while the card about the Pharisees speaking up (1-2) was kept, so a more important question is missing.
